notes: Retest mode: ran the full backend pytest suite first (16 passed after adding 2 new files), then re-ran all 13 existing named browser checks by name only (no script resent), per instructions.

This iteration's briefing shifted focus to backend refactor safety (start/complete_simulation, _scenario_from_custom, analytics, insights team_view) and concurrency guards. The refactor's UI-facing behaviors (retry-moment flow, end-simulation hard stop, mic-check, demo, auth) were already covered by iteration_5's persisted browser checks and re-passed unchanged.

Two NEW backend test files were added to close gaps the previous iteration's suite didn't explicitly cover: (1) test_tscheck_fourth_active_simulation_rejected.py for the '4th concurrent active simulation -> 409' criterion (_guard_new_simulation's active>=3 cap, confirmed in routers/simulations.py), and (2) test_tscheck_dashboard_and_team_view.py for the dashboard readiness shape and GET /api/teams/{org} shape criteria (build_readiness/earned_badges and team_view/_lapsed_names).

No new browser checks were needed: the retry-moment, end-simulation-hard-stop, mic-check, demo-launch and auth UI flows in the matrix map 1:1 onto already-named checks, re-run by name per retest-mode rules.

spec_deviations from the briefing (un-split Scorecard/SkillModule/BusinessSetup/Team, decorative index keys, bearer token in localStorage, anonymous 401 on /api/auth/me) remain accepted as intentional, not flagged as bugs.
Console noise across all checks was limited to the expected anonymous 401 probe on GET /api/auth/me and the expected 409s from the intentional double-click/concurrency hard-stop tests.
